items.html: And when they coupled together, a new light was born from them through this coupling. This new light is the aspect of the name MA of Alephs. It, too, divides into four phases, TNTA, which include the whole of Atzilut, as follows: the Taamim of MA are the aspect of Atik Yomin, the Nekudot of MA are AA, the Tagin of MA are AVI, and the Otiot of MA are ZON. And the existence of this name MA of Alephs issues from the forehead of AK.
